readmeExcerpt:
# Knowledge Catalog

[Knowledge Catalog](https://cloud.google.com/products/knowledge-catalog) (formerly Dataplex), is an AI-powered data catalog and metadata management platform. It provides a dynamic knowledge graph of all your data, structured and unstructured, to provide semantics and business context to AI agents

This repository features tools, agents, and samples that demonstrate Knowledge Catalog features, and building context management, enrichment and retrieval solutions.

aiSummary.oneLiner: An AI-powered data catalog providing a dynamic knowledge graph for context-aware enterprise AI agents.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Knowledge Catalog functions as a robust, enterprise-grade metadata management platform originally built by Google Cloud. It efficiently ingests both structured and unstructured enterprise data to automatically construct a dynamic, comprehensive knowledge graph of an organization's assets. This sophisticated graph directly provides crucial semantic and business context to AI agents, actively enabling them to ground their responses in organizational reality and reduce hallucinations. The open-source repository serves as an extensive collection of tools, sample agents, and reference architectures explicitly for building context enrichment and retrieval solutions on top of the catalog.
keyFeatures: Dynamic knowledge graph: Automatically links disparate structured and unstructured enterprise data into a single, coherent semantic network.
AI agent context: Directly provides robust business context and precise semantics to accurately ground AI agent responses.
Metadata management: Offers a comprehensive suite of tools for accurately tracking, cataloging, and managing massive enterprise data assets.
Reference architectures: Includes detailed sample code and integrated tools demonstrating how to build robust, scalable retrieval solutions.
Multi-format support: Seamlessly processes, handles, and connects various data formats ranging from relational SQL databases to raw text documents.

useCases.title: Enterprise RAG systems
useCases.description: Engineering teams can securely use the catalog to provide highly accurate, organization-specific context to Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines.

useCases.title: Data discovery
useCases.description: Data scientists can leverage the dynamic knowledge graph to rapidly locate and deeply understand relevant datasets across massive enterprise environments.

useCases.title: AI agent grounding
useCases.description: Platform developers can connect autonomous agents to the catalog to verify their actions are strictly based on current, approved business rules.

useCases.title: Metadata standardization
useCases.description: Data governance teams can systematically enforce consistent metadata tagging and semantics across all varied company assets.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Knowledge Catalog is heavily designed for enterprise data engineers, AI developers, and system architects responsible for building context-aware applications. It strictly requires an active Google Cloud Platform environment and deep familiarity with enterprise data.
